test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters, M, N, O, P, Q and R are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the letter on the face opposite N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebf574824215bbfb943e20cd6e281ae0e62f0ad5674eeaffa06086a34128f71e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f03b1fa3ee62fdc1d38e6da28e2187f5900b1895b938b8273d62d958b62515be.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As N is common on both the dices I and III, it is clear that Q, O, P, and R are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. M will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb1741a1ffa9272ffefa13906fda788c0b1d5bf0c1ce112f0aeb24e38d206f18.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2c9e2ca23b976b5c2483a8d1accb83af5c35315732e9ef86e2eb26746a998f9.png] 

Opposite pairs:

O → P

Q → R

N → M

So, the opposite side of "N" will be side "M".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
